core_meaning.short_meaning: Protector, guardian; also “capital city” in Arabic
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Aasimah represents Arabic عاصمة (ʿāṣimah), associated with protection and safeguarding; the same word also means “capital city” in modern Arabic.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Arabic عاصمة is the feminine form associated with عاصم (ʿāṣim) and the root ع ص م, with a protection/safeguarding sense. It is also the ordinary modern Arabic word for a capital city. Aasimah is a fuller romanization; Aasima is a variant spelling. Urdu personal-name spelling may appear as عاصمہ.
